actual_consumers: Native IR translator constraint builders consume typed IR/AST outputs and preserve lexical scope labels.
TAC expression/statement handlers are fully annotated; stdlib NodeTransformer visit results are decoded at their actual host boundary, not treated as Any or hidden behind fake solver protocols.
TempVarGenerator keeps context-specific cache identity, mutable builders and generation sequence.

module_ast_differential.canonicalization: Only missing optional type_params fields become empty lists in both trees; source coordinates and every other AST field retained.

strong_exploration.note: Earlier exploratory Any-expression scan retained stdlib AST dispatch/get_ir/metadata provenance. No strong qualification inferred; this slice ordinary-scoped.

explicit_deltas: Module-only source profile remains supported. Preexisting visit_Expression passed ast.expr to visit_Expr and attempted Expression(body=list[stmt]); it never formed valid executable expression-root output. It now raises explicit TypeError at this unsupported root. Parent/root authorized this diagnostic change.
First overwritten visit_BoolOp definition removed; the last runtime binding is preserved.

AST constructors now initialize required Python3.12 type_params fields to empty, matching the old omitted/default profile. Extra ctx metadata formerly passed as unsupported constructor keywords remains attached via the AST host boundary.
Malformed unnormalized subscript/yield/expression metadata may receive explicit validation errors; no supported source Module path discarded.
